name: laying with the dead on broken concrete
source:
a short kinetic visual novel made in about 7 hours. you are a fallen angel, recalling the memories you have of the dead girl whose form you have taken.

[From [url=https://catsket.itch.io/concrete]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部耗时约7小时的短篇动态视觉小说。你是一个堕落的天使，回忆起你所化身的死去女孩的记忆。

[来自[url=https://catsket.itch.io/concrete]Itch.io[/url]]
